seal.statement: Every fallback site the detector module reports (two-source reads, typeof dual paths, catch-and-default) has a census record in data/fallback-census/census.json: the site's file, range and content hash, the class derived from V8 block coverage collected with NODE_V8_COVERAGE over the unit, packaging, integration and bootstrap corpus and one fresh-formation scenario (never, primary-only, fallback-only, both, or unloaded when no run loaded the file), and the identity of every run that contributed; the census is produced by one script under scripts/checks that merges the per-process coverage files and joins them to the detector sites, so that the budget row fallback_sites_uncensused reads zero at the head the census was taken on.
